waivers.reason: FALSE POSITIVE - check_silk.py bug. Its shape builder (check_silk.py lines 161-166) converts any *_rect into Polygon(pts).buffer(w2), i.e. it treats the rectangle INTERIOR as solid ink and ignores the fill token entirely. J1's F.SilkS rect carries an explicit '(fill no)' and is an outline of 0.12 mm stroke around the connector body - it does not cover any pad. Three independent proofs: (1) the fill token is literally 'no' in lib/aiee.pretty/SMA_BAT_Wireless_BWSMA-KWE-Z001.kicad_mod; (2) the reported areas are EXACT full-pad areas (5.26 mm2 vs the 2.3x2.3 mm centre pad, 3.80 mm2 vs pi*1.1^2 for a 2.2 mm corner pad) - only a filled interior produces whole-pad coverage; (3) kicad-cli DRC --severity-all on this same board reports ZERO silk findings, and the drc_routed gate (which fails on warnings too) passes 0/0. The footprint is KiCad's own stock part, cloned byte-for-byte apart from an added Datasheet property. Deforming a correct stock footprint to satisfy a checker that mis-parses fill would be the actual defect.

waivers.reason: STRUCTURAL - not fixable in any layout. Both ERROR findings are the antipads of the /RF THROUGH-HOLE pads in the B.Cu ground pour: J1's centre pin (2.04 mm2 deficit, 0.30 mm of trace crossing) and C1's insulated RF lead (1.46 mm2, 0.15 mm). A through-hole RF pin cannot exist without a clearance void in the opposite-layer plane; removing the void would short RF to GND. At J1 the void IS the coax launch - its four ground legs straddle it, which is the correct launch geometry for a THT SMA jack. Everywhere else the B.Cu return is unbroken under the entire RF run (B.Cu pour 452.58 mm2, ONE island, byte-for-byte the same fill as before the 2026-08-09 inductance re-route - the meander is F.Cu only and punches no new holes; F.Cu pour also one island, 311.88 mm2; 68 stitching vias, 8 of them within the declared 2.0 mm return_via_radius of each R1 strap land). Total crossing is 0.45 mm of a 42.51 mm trace (1.1 percent). The physical return-loop inductance this represents is inside the residual budget: ~20 nH total = 3.17 ohm at 25 MHz against a 12.07 ohm / 76.9 nH failure threshold, a 3.8x margin. NOTE the C1 antipad area moved 0.74 -> 1.46 mm2 purely as a tool artifact: check_return_path buffers each chain by k x its WIDEST track, and deleting the 7.34 mm lap-pad flare shrank that buffer from 22.0 mm to 8.2 mm, which changes how much of the fixed annulus falls inside the corridor. Nothing physical at C1 changed - the crossing length is identical at 0.1505 mm.
